ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure is a square sheet of paper, divided by a vertical cutting line running through the full height into left and right two parts. The narrow vertical strip on the left is further divided by two horizontal cutting lines that only pass through the left vertical strip into 3 rectangles; the wide vertical strip on the right is also divided by two horizontal cutting lines that only pass through the right vertical strip into 3 rectangles, so there are 6 rectangles in total. Then reason: Let the side length of the square be s, and the width of the left vertical strip be a, then the width of the right vertical strip is s-a. When adding the perimeters of the 6 rectangles, the outer boundary is counted only once, contributing 4s; the internal cutting lines are all counted twice. The total length of the internal cutting lines is: the length s of the middle vertical cutting line, plus the total length 2a of the two horizontal cutting lines on the left, plus the total length 2(s-a) of the two horizontal cutting lines on the right. So the total internal length is s+2a+2(s-a)=3s. Therefore the sum of the perimeters of the six pieces is 4s+2(3s)=10s. It is known that the total sum is 120 cm, so 10s=120, obtaining s=12 cm. The area of the square is s^2=12^2=144 cm^2.

raw_record.question_text: A square piece of paper is cut into six rectangular pieces as shown on the right. The sum of the perimeters of the six pieces is $120 \mathrm{~cm}$. How big is the area of the square?

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: the square is split by one full-height vertical cut into a left strip and a right strip. The left strip is divided into 3 rectangles by two horizontal cuts across only the left strip, and the right strip is divided into 3 rectangles by two horizontal cuts across only the right strip, making 6 rectangles total. Let the square side length be s and the left strip width be a, so the right strip width is s-a. From the text, the sum of all six rectangle perimeters is 120 cm. Use the rule that when summing perimeters of all pieces, the square's outer boundary contributes 4s once, and every internal cut contributes twice. The internal cut lengths are: the full vertical cut s, two left-strip horizontal cuts totaling 2a, and two right-strip horizontal cuts totaling 2(s-a). Thus total internal length is s+2a+2(s-a)=3s. Therefore total piece perimeter is 4s+2(3s)=10s. Set 10s=120, get s=12, so the square area is s^2=144 cm^2.

先描述图像：图中是一个正方形纸片，被一条贯穿全高的竖直切线分成左、右两部分。左边窄竖带又被两条只穿过左竖带的水平切线分成3个长方形；右边宽竖带也被两条只穿过右竖带的水平切线分成3个长方形，所以一共是6个长方形。

再推理：设正方形边长为 s，左竖带宽为 a，则右竖带宽为 s-a。把6个长方形的周长相加时，外边界只算一次，贡献 4s；内部切线都算两次。内部切线总长度为：中间那条竖切线长度 s，加上左边两条水平切线总长 2a，加上右边两条水平切线总长 2(s-a)。所以内部总长为 s+2a+2(s-a)=3s。

因此六块的周长和为 4s+2(3s)=10s。已知总和是 120 cm，所以 10s=120，得 s=12 cm。正方形面积为 s^2=12^2=144 cm^2。
